passage: Last Sunday, our neighborhood organized a tree-planting event. It started at nine in the morning and finished at twelve. About fifty people joined, including children and old people. The organizer gave each person a small tree and a shovel. We walked to an empty field behind the school. The ground was hard, so we had to dig with care. My neighbor Mr. Li showed me how to plant the tree correctly. He said the roots need to be deep, and the soil must be tight. After we planted our trees, we watered them with buckets of water. At noon, the organizer gave everyone a bottle of water and a warm smile. The field now has twenty new trees. I felt tired but proud. Next spring, the trees will be green and strong. It was a small act, but it makes our home more beautiful.

sentences.text: The organizer gave each person a small tree and a shovel.
My neighbor Mr. Li showed me how to plant the tree correctly.

vocab.note: 词尾 -er，重音在前；与动词 organize 区分
